title: Use DomoAI’s current plans (which include Seedance 2 support) instead of…
content:
Use DomoAI’s current plans (which include Seedance 2 support) instead of “expensive platforms” to reduce per-video cost, especially for frequent Shorts/Reels/TikTok production.
In DomoAI with Seedance 2.0, generate character-to-video by selecting a reference video and uploading your character image to drive motion and achieve more cinematic movement.
